text:
anya: quick thread - proposing a microbench "sampler" in the onboarding flow to catch perf regressions cheaply. core idea: always run tiny checks (seq=32) + mid checks (seq=256 w/ warmup), and probabilistically run long checks (seq=1024) based on model size. comments?
chris: sounds useful. keep it low-friction. suggestion: seq=32 (100%); seq=256 (100% w/ 2 warmup runs); seq=1024 (sampled). attach reason codes: ABI_OK / PERF_OK / PERF_DEGRADED / ABI_FAIL so infra can route.
tejas: add KV-cache steady-state probe (run a short prefix loop after warmup) for the 256/1024 cases. without that we miss long-run throughput drops. also recommend tracking p50/p95 and tokens/sec.
marco: ops note: we can't block rollouts for small p50 blips. propose policy: ABI_FAIL -> block; correctness regressions -> block; perf_degraded -> halt canary + escalate. allow a team toggle for auto-rollback in aggressive mode.
lina: on sampling probability, use a simple heuristic: sample_rate = clamp(0.05 * (1 / sqrt(size_gb)), 0.005, 0.25). big models get very small sample rates. store seed + job-id for reproducibility.
anya: agreed. draft YAML snippet I'm planning to put in the model manifest: ```
perf_sampler:
  enabled: true
  checks:
    - name: tiny
      seq: 32
      repeats: 1
      sample_rate: 1.0
    - name: mid
      seq: 256
      repeats: 3
      warmup: 2
      sample_rate: 1.0
    - name: long
      seq: 1024
      repeats: 5
      warmup: 3
      sample_rate: dynamic # computed by infra heuristic
  thresholds:
    p50_mult: 1.15
    tokens_per_sec_drop: 0.05
  outcome_actions:
    ABI_FAIL: block_rollout
    CORRECTNESS_FAIL: block_rollout
    PERF_DEGRADED: halt_canary
```

chris: infra — include est_gpu_minutes in the event payload, and a breakdown per-check so product can show cost tradeoffs in the UI.
tejas: also log a compact fingerprint (abi_hash, qtype, opset) so we can diff failures over time.
anya: i'll open a short RFC/PR with the YAML + sampling formula + a small spreadsheet of baseline thresholds. will add a dev-mode to run without billing impact. thanks all.
